images.seen: Plausible overall; Mapuche (3,694 cells) takes the Pampas and Patagonia, Diriyah is huge, Aragon/Navarre/Biscay are the French military governments.
Upper Peru under Peru (Abascal), Chile as a thin patriot strip, big grey Amazon and Chaco holes; Mapuche overlaps Chilean land north of the Biobio (ruling).
Spanish reconquest of Chile, Federal League, Paraguay and Portuguese Guianas look right; New Granada patriot core on the Andes.

WRONG: grey hole in Aragon/Navarre/Catalonia (213 cells, 1812-1813), grey holes of ~350 cells in Lithuania, Belarus and Smolensk-Moscow (end 1812); Denmark-Norway wrongly drawn in vassal tint (fixed by the p1500 window's patch).

WRONG: hatched contest over all of Najd from 1811 (Ottoman ledger/163 and Muhammad Ali ledger/2 run Hejaz+Najd together), while the Hejaz coast is already drawn as Habesh Eyalet although the Saudis held Mecca and Medina to 1813.
WRONG: Congress Poland is a 46-cell speck inside direct Russian land (Russian ledger/65 applied first); rest of Vienna settlement (Posen, Krakow, Lombardy-Venetia, Bavaria, Hanover) looks right.
Third Anglo-Maratha War result, princely states as vassals, Nepal after Sugauli, Bhutan, Burmese Assam all look right; a grey patch in Bastar/Orissa has no state to give it to.
War of 1812 hatch over Michigan/Wisconsin still drawn at end of 1813 although Detroit was retaken that year (left); Spanish Florida shrunk to the peninsula.
Gran Colombia, third republic of Venezuela and the royalist coast look right; Gran Colombia holds 756 cells inside Brazil's Amazonas from Cliopatria's 1820 shape (left).
North-east Spain is French, Lithuania/Belarus/Smolensk Russian again, Denmark-Norway in its own colour.
Najd and the south Hejaz are Saudi, the Ottoman/Egyptian hold is the north Hejaz coast; no hatch.
